title: Add `--format` to `podman manifest inspect`
body:
### Feature request description

Most of our commands that return structured data have a `--format` option to have a user-configurable way of printing only parts of that data. The `podman manifest inspect` command doesn't have this.

### Suggest potential solution

Add a `--format` option to `podman manifest inspect` with an implementation similar to that of `podman inspect` (and its `--format` option)

### Have you considered any alternatives?

N/A

### Additional context

N/A
